noticeSelectionBoundary: Every regular source-archive file with a case-insensitive basename matching LICENSE, LICENCE, COPYING, COPYRIGHT, PATENTS, NOTICE or NOTICES followed by an optional dot/underscore/hyphen suffix. This capture does not assert that all embedded source notices or upstream dependency licenses have been identified.
manifestReconstructionBoundary: Re-read the pinned original source tar archive, map all regular members after removing their single top directory to file/bytes/sha256 rows, apply every delta output and removal, sort paths using Python PurePosixPath, and serialize exactly as declared in each delta. All eight reconstructions were checked against the full observed SDK manifest SHA-256. Modes, symlinks, module loads and publisher identity are separate.

originalGeneratorReplay.scope: Complete original Go Fiat generators compiled with the C-root source-built Linux Go 1.24.13 SDK; generation runs in separate containers mounting only compiled generator, source-built addchain and Fiat producer, source-built GMP and a finite argv bridge. Full Go SDK, original source archives and selected expected output files are not mounted during generation. This is a scoped replay, not the original publisher build or complete C/base-image/bootstrap/notice closure.
